source_variant: default release, FAITHFUL undefined; lexical inventory retains alternate branches as a conservative superset

inventory_scope.limitation: This is the battle boundary and shared dependencies, not a proof of transitive call-graph closure. External field scripts, UI and data references still require end-to-end evidence.

domains.title: Battle setup and trainer/wild construction
obligations: All source trainer parties, attributes, DV/stat/ability selection, wild generation, battle types, start/end persistence and special scripted opponents.

domains.title: Action selection, order and cancellation
obligations: Full priority/speed ordering, ties, switching/items/run ordering, obedience, recharge/flinch/status/Disable/Encore/PP interactions and random call order.

domains.title: Damage, criticals, types, accuracy and stats
obligations: Every arithmetic boundary and modifier order: stat stages, criticals, STAB, effectiveness, burn, items, abilities, weather, screens, integer rounding and saturation.
Accuracy/evasion combination, immunities, hit exceptions and all byte/range RNG decisions.

domains.title: Every move and effect command
obligations: All 255 source identities, 133 effects and 129 commands: all success/failure branches, called/multi-turn moves, copy/transform/history, PP, recoil/drain, Substitute/Protect, switches and fainting.

domains.title: Major status and volatile state
obligations: Application, immunity, cure/reflection order, duration, action blocking, self-confusion damage, switch/party persistence and simultaneous conditions.

domains.title: Abilities and suppression
obligations: Every source ability, trigger and rejection branch; active/stored/suppressed ability identity; contact, faint, entry, end-turn, Unnerve, Neutralizing Gas, Mold Breaker and copying.

domains.title: Held and trainer/player-used items
obligations: All held-effect parameter values and consumptions, cure/berry gates, damage/reactive items, removal/recovery, in-battle use, restrictions and inventory/party persistence.

domains.title: Weather, screens and residual event order
obligations: Weather durations, suppression and immunity; screen timers; each residual fraction and ordered event; cures, items, delayed attacks and replacement after every faint boundary.

domains.title: Switching, trapping and entry hazards
obligations: Voluntary/forced/pivot switches, traps, Baton Pass, Pursuit, hazard ordering, switch abilities/items, reset/persist state and replacement selection.

domains.title: Fainting and battle outcomes
obligations: Global contact/recoil/residual/faint ordering, Destiny Bond/Aftermath, simultaneous knockouts, last-Pokemon outcomes, forced replacements and cleanup.

domains.title: Capture and fleeing
obligations: Every ball modifier and capture arithmetic, status/HP rounding, guaranteed/restricted captures, party/box/Pokedex delivery, run/escape attempts, fleeing and roaming persistence.

domains.title: Experience, money and post-battle changes
obligations: Participant/Exp Share distribution, growth/stat changes, learning/evolution cancellation, happiness, money/Pay Day, losses and saved outcome state.

domains.title: AI decisions and information
obligations: Source scoring tiers and every move/effect heuristic, choice tie breaks, item and switch decisions, permitted information and battle modes. Native timing checks prove performance only.

domains.title: Facility and link-specific rules
obligations: Battle Tower party generation, tier restrictions, outcomes and persistence; source link battle rules and synchronization. Native facilities/doubles/gimmicks remain optional extensions.

domains.title: Shared RNG and observable sequencing
obligations: Exact random stream/call count and source battle messages/animations/timing. A probability match or native animation does not establish these.
